gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, with gentle stroke modulation and terminals pulled well back, so the lines feel measured. Jelly Crazies wobbles above it, and the reading slows to a leisurely walk.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-serif-h: Noto Serif Hentaigana opens every curved stroke into a jaw and keeps its small letters nearly capital height, with subtle visible modulation. Jelly Crazies, with bowls nearly shut, gives that openness something to lean against.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-ovo: Ovo reads classic and authoritative, with thins barely lighter than thicks. Jelly Crazies can go big with its wobbly, nearly sealed bowls, while Ovo's spacious curve terminals and shallow ascenders stay quietly in the background.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-domine: Widely tracked lettering gives Joystix its arcade swagger, while Domine sits below with compact ascenders and a breathing space inside each curve. Bold arcade shout meets refined, dignified restraint.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-faustina: Stems barely heavier than their connecting arms give Joystix a bold arcade punch up top. But Faustina, its bowls thinning gracefully around an open-jawed c, does the classic, authoritative talking.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hedvig-letters-ser: Wide-set arcade swagger, courtesy of Joystix, up top. Hedvig Letters Serif follows with open-ended curves, a sturdy lowercase and medium-key contrast, so long paragraphs would read with classic authority.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-lisu-bosa: Arcade energy runs through Joystix, with widely tracked letters and stems barely heavier than their arms. And Lisu Bosa's large, sturdy-looking words and spilling counters give the pairing its editorial footing.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab reads traditional and refined, with robust downstrokes, slender turns and an open channel in the e. And Joystix, widely tracked and arcade-loud, belongs in big, brief headings where its bold shout lands.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-ovo: Joystix brings widely tracked, arcade-bold lettering with stems barely heavier than its connecting arms. And Ovo, with thins only slightly lighter than thicks and spacious gaps at curve terminals, handles the classic, authoritative reading.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-halant: Outward-pointing terminals and a faint thick-thin shift give the body its authoritative, traditional voice. Halant does that job well, while Junegull, retro and friendly with no thick-thin flicker, handles the greeting up top.
